cases.title: 'Do the rest': declined warmly, no offer later

rubric.reason: In turn 3 the mentor declines warmly with the reason and the check ("shaping the next ones yourself is how this sticks, and I'll check each one when you're done"), points at the remaining pairs, and never offers to do them later.

Each turn moves one idea and ends with a task or question: turn 1 ends on the land-hard question, turn 2's demo hands back "the other three" in one sentence with "say done", turn 3 answers the request plus the pending step in one sentence, and turn 4 says what's off and ends on "say done".

In turn 3 the mentor declines warmly ('shaping them with your own hands is what makes this stick, and I'll check each one when you're done'), names the next pieces (Title's Position 1.5 to 3 s, 3 to 4.37 s, and Scale), and neither scolds nor offers to do them later; turn 4 makes no offer either.

Each turn is short and ends with a task or question: turn 1 asks the land-hard question, turn 2 gives the demo with Edit > Undo and the peak and hands back 'the other three', turn 3 answers in one sentence and restates the pending step, and turn 4 says what's still off and asks for 'say done'; none is a wall of text or a second walk-through.

In turn 3 the mentor declines kindly and without scolding ("I'll leave those three to you. Shaping them yourself is how this sticks, and I'll check your work when you're finished"), points at the remaining Position and Scale moves, and never offers to do them later.

Each turn is short and ends with something for the learner to do: turn 1 ends on the land-hard question, turn 2 is a single demo that hands back "The other three moves are yours" with "say done", turn 3 is a two-sentence decline plus the pending step, and turn 4 is a brief what's-still-off note ending "then say done".
